Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Interactive PvP combat frames, reliable held-action scheduling, LB cues, and survival helpers.
Description: A local PvP HUD with fixed Self/S1-S5 combat frames, optional exact row targeting and mouseover, calibrated LB gauges, direct ally LB damage, pressure and CC cues, a bounded held-action scheduler, reactive counter-CC, survival and job helpers, explicit PvP macros, low-MP Focus, assists, team communication, and target highlights.
Changelog: Adds a default-off exact CC NIN held helper for enemies strictly below 20% HP while live Guard/Wehr is active. It freezes one canonical S-slot actor, uses current-patch Shukuchi 29513 at that actor's revalidated position within 20 yalms, and hard-targets only that same enemy after a client-accepted jump. Positive fresh pressure is only a ranking bonus; missing pressure and unrelated enemy slots never block. Own Guard suppresses the automatic helper, /panicshu remains the sole own-Guard exception, and Purify/reactive CC/Rescue/Guardian retain priority. Proven client-false retries stay same-actor and bounded; continuous hold needs a real cooldown-unavailable to ready epoch before another jump. Adds schema 31 with the option off for new, upgraded, and reset configurations.
